description:
Cross-evaluation of the optimum under a rotor-speed ceiling
(2026-09-19; docs/journal/CROSS_EVALUATION_ROTOR_SPEED_CEILING.md).
operating_law: lambda(V) = min(design_tsr, V_tip,max / V); the '300 rpm' case is the machine ceiling from config (max_tip_speed_ms)
bounds: configured bounds (chord_max_m = 0.30 m, max_local_solidity = 0.5). x* and x0 satisfy them; the audit's ceiling-optimised context blades opt_60/55/50 do not -- they were optimised under the retired 0.45 m provisional cap, so they are context, not candidates
